title: Customer Success Engineer — Careers at Tasklet
excerpt: Our users are building real automations with Tasklet — connecting dozens of services, writing complex workflows, and trusting an AI agent with critical work. When something breaks or gets confusing, the quality of help they get determines whether they go deeper or give up. But we don't want to solve this just by throwing people at support tickets. We want to solve it by making everything work better — through better product, better self-serve resources, smarter automation, and better internal tooling.
content_html:
About the role

Tasklet is building the AI platform companies use to run their business on agents. A customer describes an outcome in plain English, and Tasklet gets the work done across their tools and systems—immediately or in the cloud 24×7.

Our users are building real automations with Tasklet — connecting dozens of services, writing complex workflows, and trusting an AI agent with critical work. When something breaks or gets confusing, the quality of help they get determines whether they go deeper or give up. But we don't want to solve this just by throwing people at support tickets. We want to solve it by making everything work better — through better product, better self-serve resources, smarter automation, and better internal tooling.

We’re looking for someone to become a core owner of our customer-facing work: handle inbound support, talk live with users, proactively help high-value customers get more out of Tasklet, and relentlessly automate and improve the system so your workload keeps going down while our customers keep getting more successful.

This is a great role for someone with roughly 1–5 years of experience who is a technology power user, great with customers, and excited to grow into a broad customer-facing role at an AI startup.

Compensation

Salary
$130k → $180k

Equity
0.05% → 0.15%

Competitive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k, 4 weeks PTO, free lunch, etc.)

Responsibilities

  • Own inbound customer support via email and calls. Diagnose and resolve complex issues across a product that touches dozens of external services, runs code, browses the web, and manages files
  • Make every customer interaction excellent. When a customer interacts with you, they should come away thinking more highly of Tasklet. You'll explain complex technical ideas clearly, make people feel understood, and create confidence that their issue is being handled well
  • Own existing customer relationships. Ensure customers are loving Tasklet, help them find new ways to use the product, and grow our relationships. Provide high-touch onboarding, training, and demos
  • Feed insights back to product and engineering. Systematically capture what's breaking, what's confusing, and what's missing, and work directly with eng to fix it — including driving some fixes yourself
  • Build AI-augmented support workflows. Use Tasklet (and other tools) to automate handling of common support requests so you can focus on the most important issues
  • Improve our internal tooling and processes. Build dashboards, admin panels, and automations that make us more efficient at serving customers
  • Create and improve self-serve resources. Write help docs, guides, examples, and internal playbooks that reduce inbound volume and help users succeed without needing to contact support

Our ideal candidate

  • You’re ambitious, have roughly 1–5 years of experience, and are looking for a high-slope opportunity at a fast-growing AI startup
  • You’ve spent time in a high-agency role where you had to quickly understand messy problems and work effectively with business customers
  • You love working with people, and you’re great at it. You’re charismatic and an unusually clear, concise communicator. You have genuine empathy for users and are a natural at building trust and goodwill
  • You’re a technology power user and love solving technical problems, whether or not you have a technical degree
  • You're AI-pilled and love to automate — you already use AI heavily in your work and life and are always looking to understand the latest AI products and features. When you see repetitive work you automate it away — you don’t just power through it

Apply by sending a video

Show us who you are.

Email andrew@tasklet.ai with your résumé, relevant links, and a video introduction no more than five minutes long.

Your video must include the following:

  • Who you are & why you want to join Tasklet
  • A confirmation that you are able to work full-time, in-person in SF (including any required work authorizations - we are not sponsoring visas at this time)
  • A demo of the most impressive thing you've made recently that’s relevant to the role you’re applying for. Make sure to show what you made, not just tell us.

Apply for this role

content_html_zh:
关于角色

Tasklet 正在构建公司用来在代理上运行业务的人工智能平台。 客户用简单的英语描述结果，Tasklet 可以通过他们的工具和系统立即或在云中 24×7 完成工作。

我们的用户正在使用 Tasklet 构建真正的自动化 - 连接数十个服务，编写复杂的工作流程，并信任人工智能代理来完成关键工作。 当事情出现问题或变得令人困惑时，他们获得的帮助的质量决定了他们是继续深入还是放弃。 但我们不想仅仅通过向人们提供支持票来解决这个问题。 我们希望通过让一切变得更好来解决这个问题——通过更好的产品、更好的自助资源、更智能的自动化和更好的内部工具。

我们正在寻找一个人来成为我们面向客户的工作的核心负责人：处理入站支持、与用户进行实时交谈、主动帮助高价值客户从 Tasklet 中获得更多收益，并不断地自动化和改进系统，以便您的工作量不断下降，同时我们的客户不断取得更大的成功。

对于拥有大约 1 到 5 年经验的技术高级用户来说，这是一个很好的角色，他们非常善于与客户合作，并且很高兴能够在人工智能初创公司中成长为面向广泛客户的角色。

赔偿

工资$130k → $180k

权益0.05% → 0.15%

有竞争力的福利（医疗、牙科、视力、401k、4周PTO、免费午餐等）

职责

  • 通过电子邮件和电话拥有入站客户支持。 诊断并解决涉及数十种外部服务、运行代码、浏览网页和管理文件的产品中的复杂问题
  • 让每一次客户互动都变得精彩。 当客户与您互动时，他们应该会更加重视 Tasklet。 您将清楚地解释复杂的技术想法，让人们感到被理解，并让他们相信他们的问题得到了很好的处理
  • 拥有现有的客户关系。 确保客户喜欢 Tasklet，帮助他们找到使用该产品的新方法，并发展我们的关系。 提供高接触性的入职、培训和演示
  • 将见解反馈给产品和工程。 系统地捕获出现问题的内容、令人困惑的内容以及缺失的内容，并直接与 eng 合作修复它 - 包括自己进行一些修复
  • 构建人工智能增强的支持工作流程。 使用 Tasklet（和其他工具）自动处理常见支持请求，以便您可以专注于最重要的问题
  • 改进我们的内部工具和流程。 构建仪表板、管理面板和自动化，使我们能够更高效地为客户提供服务
  • 创建和改进自助服务资源。 编写帮助文档、指南、示例和内部手册，以减少入站量并帮助用户取得成功，而无需联系支持人员

我们的理想人选

  • 您雄心勃勃，拥有大约 1-5 年的经验，并且正在快速发展的人工智能初创公司寻找高发展机会
  • 您曾担任过高级代理角色，必须快速了解混乱的问题并与业务客户有效合作
  • 你喜欢与人合作，而且你很擅长。 你很有魅力，并且是一个异常清晰、简洁的沟通者。 您对用户有真正的同理心，并且天生善于建立信任和善意
  • 您是一名技术高级用户，喜欢解决技术问题，无论您是否拥有技术学位
  • 您热衷于人工智能，热爱自动化——您已经在工作和生活中大量使用人工智能，并且一直在寻求了解最新的人工智能产品和功能。 当你看到重复性工作时，你可以将其自动化——你不只是通过它来完成它

通过发送视频申请

告诉我们你是谁。

发送电子邮件至 andrew@tasklet.ai，附上您的简历、相关链接以及时长不超过五分钟的视频介绍。
